text:
**Date:** The recall was announced on 14 March 2025.

**Named person:** Henrik Aalvik, Head of Quality Assurance at Lindqvist Dairy, confirmed the withdrawal.

**Figure:** 18,400 units of Lindqvist Dairy oat yoghurt (450 g tubs) were affected.

**Document/event:** The report rests on Recall Notice LD-2025-031, issued by the Northvale Food Standards Board after routine testing found undeclared allergen traces.
